# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# fields: COMMAND_RPC_GET_HEIGHT::response_t, src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server_commands_defs.h:464-470
#         -> ONE key, `height` (uint64_t). NO status/untrusted: the wallet RPC has no
#         rpc_response_base, so this is the whole answer.
# request: empty (:457-461).
# THE HOT-PATH PROBE, AND THREE ANSWERS IN ONE CALL (DESIGN.md §5): this call is simultaneously the
#         wallet's reachability probe AND its open/closed probe --
#           a `height` answer      => reachable AND a wallet is open
#           -13 NOT_OPEN           => reachable AND no wallet open (error-not-open.json; reachable
#                                     with a JSON-RPC error is still `reachable: true`)
#           a transport error      => unreachable
#         With the wallet closed there is nothing to spend two guaranteed -13s on, which is why
#         status makes three calls with it closed and five with it open.
# THIS IS THE WALLET'S OWN HEIGHT, AND IT IS THE CLOCK FOR `confirmations` AND `locked`.
#         on_get_height returns m_wallet->get_blockchain_current_height()
#         (src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server.cpp:938-944) -- the same function wallet-rpc itself uses to
#         recompute those two derived fields on every get_transfers response (:162, called at :505,
#         :535, :566, :589). DESIGN.md §1b.4/§5b: fmonero must recompute them against THIS number and
#         never against the node's get_info.height, or it tells the user a payment is more settled
#         than the wallet can see.
# SAME CONVENTION AS THE NODE'S HEIGHT: both are top + 1, so status.wallet.blocks_behind =
#         node.height - wallet.height is well defined. 3541122 equals node/get_info.json's height, so
#         a mock serving both roles from tests/fixtures/ yields blocks_behind 0 and the
#         `wallet_behind` warning does not fire. get_height-behind.json is the fixture that makes it
#         fire.
